## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(916)

#Simulate the structure of the real data, based on the data of OECD
country_region <- tibble(
  country = c("Canada", "United States",
              "Mexico", "Costa Rica", "Colombia", "Chile",
              "Australia", "New Zealand",
              "Austria", "Belgium", "France", "Germany", "Luxembourg",
              "Netherlands", "Switzerland",
              "Estonia", "Ireland", "Latvia", "Lithuania", "Norway",
              "Sweden", "United Kingdom",
              "Greece", "Italy", "Portugal", "Slovenia", "Spain",
              "Bulgaria", "Czechia", "Hungary", "Poland", "Romania",
              "Slovak Republic"),
  region  = c(rep("Northern America", 2),
              rep("Latin America", 4),
              rep("Oceania", 2),
              rep("Western Europe", 7),
              rep("Northern Europe", 7),
              rep("Southern Europe", 5),
              rep("Eastern Europe", 6))
)

head(country_region)
```

```{r}
#建立個人性質
n_countries <- length(country_region$country)   # 33

simulated_ppl <- tibble(
  country = rep(country_region$country, each = 12),
  sex = rep(rep(c("Female", "Male"), each = 6), times = n_countries),
  education = rep(rep(c("Below upper secondary",
                        "Upper secondary / post-secondary non-tertiary",
                        "Tertiary"), each = 2),
                  times = 2 * n_countries),
  arrival_age = rep(c("Arrived before age 16", "Arrived at age 16 or older"),
                    times = 6 * n_countries)
)

head(simulated_ppl)
```

```{r}
#add region and development group
simulated_groups <- 
  simulated_ppl |>
  left_join(country_region, by = "country") |>
  mutate(
    development_group = case_match(
      region,
      c("Northern America", "Oceania", "Western Europe", "Northern Europe") ~ "More developed",
      c("Latin America", "Southern Europe", "Eastern Europe") ~ "Less developed",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  )

head(simulated_groups)
```

```{r}
#expected unemployment rate
simulated_rates <- simulated_groups |>
  mutate(
    unemployment_rate = 3 +
      if_else(development_group == "Less developed", 2.5, 0, missing = 0) +
      case_match(education,
                 "Below upper secondary" ~ 3,
                 "Upper secondary / post-secondary non-tertiary" ~ 0,
                 "Tertiary" ~ -2) +
      if_else(sex == "Female", 0.5, 0) +
      if_else(arrival_age == "Arrived before age 16", -1, 0)
  )

head(simulated_rates)
```

```{r}
simulated_data <- simulated_rates |>
  select(region, development_group, sex, education,
         arrival_age, unemployment_rate)

head(simulated_data)
```

```{r}
women_tertiary_simulated <- simulated_data |>
  filter(sex == "Female",
         education == "Tertiary") |>
  drop_na(development_group, unemployment_rate)

#取發展好、不好的國家各自的平均
mean_by_group <- women_tertiary_simulated |>
  group_by(development_group) |>
  summarise(mean_rate = mean(unemployment_rate))
```

**現在來試試看畫圖吧**

```{r}
mean_by_group |>
  ggplot(aes(x = development_group, y = mean_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Mean unemployment rate",
       title = "Simulated: tertiary-educated foreign-born women")
```

```{r}
women_tertiary_simulated |>
  group_by(region, development_group) |>
  summarise(mean_rate = mean(unemployment_rate), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = mean_rate, fill = development_group)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Mean unemployment rate",
       fill = "Group",
       title = "Simulated: tertiary-educated foreign-born women, by region")
```

**第二個假設**

```{r}
mean_by_group_arrival <- women_tertiary_simulated |>
  group_by(development_group, arrival_age) |>
  summarise(mean_rate = mean(unemployment_rate),
            .groups = "drop")

mean_by_group_arrival
```

```{r}
mean_by_group_arrival |>
  ggplot(aes(x = development_group, y = mean_rate, fill = arrival_age)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Mean unemployment rate",
       fill = "Age at arrival",
       title = "Simulated: tertiary-educated foreign-born women")
```
